faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) position is 04-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) post at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. in Physical Sciences with specialization in Photonics, Fiber Optics, and Medical Optics; OR M.Tech. in Optics and Instrumentation with three years of experience; OR M.Sc. in Physics with four years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is ₹56,000/- per month plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-medical) post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview via email.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.answer: The official notification link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
